signatures.description: Given asynchronously streamed sparse voxel bricks with mixed-resolution neighbors, reconstruct crack-free boundary meshes while honoring a strict GPU memory budget and allowing bricks to arrive, disappear, or be replaced during rendering. Implement a WebGPU-side scheduling and seam-stitching strategy that avoids stale-buffer races, minimizes rebuild work, and guarantees identical shared-face topology regardless of arrival order.
